h100: exploratory records retained; excluded from final comparison; no active local benchmark workers at scope change
selection: minimum measured p50 among configurations passing that model existing quality acceptance standard
distilled_schedules: eligible under the same quality requirement; unqualified candidates remain diagnostic only
primary_table: one quality-admitted winner per model and framework; configuration explicit
quality_admission: reuse each model existing metric, reference, margin and confidence rule; require evidence matching actual deployed candidate
